Presenting the highly loved OST from blockbuster movie , a Malayalam crime thriller written and directed by Midhun Manuel Thomas. The movie stars Kunchacko Boban, Sharaf U Dheen, Unni Maya, Indrans, Sreenath Bhasi, Ramya Nambeesan, Jinu Joseph among others. Cinematography by Shyju Khalid, Edited by Saiju Sreedharan, Music by Sushin Shyam, Produced by Ashiq Usman under the banner of Ashiq Usman Productions. Muzik247 is the official music partner.
Track : Fidget Spinner
Music : Sushin Shyam
Additional Music Producers : Nezer Ahemed, Saeed Abbas, Sandeep Thulasidas
Viola/Violin : Danny john
